items.headline: Pre-existing disease waiting period rejection is incorrect
items.explanation: The insurer rejected the claim under policy:5.1 citing a pre-existing disease waiting period, but the patient has 40 months of continuous coverage which exceeds the 36-month statutory maximum under IRDAI_PED_36M. This wrongful rejection puts {{flag.WAITING_REJECTION_INVALID.amount}} at risk, and an appeal can recover {{flag.WAITING_REJECTION_INVALID.recoverable}}.
items.fix: File an appeal with the insurer attaching proof of continuous coverage exceeding the waiting period.

items.headline: Investigation reports missing from claim file
items.explanation: Under policy:9.2, claims must be supported by investigation reports to establish medical necessity. Line 7 diagnostics lack these reports, placing {{flag.DOC_MISSING-investigation_reports.amount}} at risk.
items.fix: Attach the missing laboratory and radiology investigation reports to complete the file.

items.headline: Implant invoice and sticker required
items.explanation: Under policy:9.2, claims involving surgical implants must include the implant invoice and sticker. Line 8 is missing this documentation, placing {{flag.DOC_MISSING-implant_invoice.amount}} at risk.
items.fix: Attach the implant invoice and sticker to the claim documents.
